Cutting.description:
Values filled into an operation when it is created with this tool. Never applied to an
existing operation.

stepover.description: Pocket stepover, a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most 1.

LibraryTool.description: One tool of the library: a project tool with a name and optional cutting values.

angle.description: V-bits: the included angle, radians. Null: unknown.

center_cutting.description: Whether it can plunge straight down. Null: unknown.

cutting.description:
Feeds, step down and stepover a new operation with this tool starts with. Never
changes an existing operation. Null: none.

id.description: The tool number it gets in a project, when that number is free there.

name.description: The tool's name, unique in the library (upper or lower case don't matter).

tip_diameter.description: V-bits: the flat tip's diameter, mm. Null: pointed.

uid.description:
What projects link the tool by: 16 lowercase hex digits, unique in the library, never
changed (docs/specs/library-in-browser.md §2).

description: Schema version 3. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

default_tool.description: The name of the tool new projects start with. Null: the built-in 6 mm endmill.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file.

title: Chipload tool library
